---
name: Research or decision (RFC)
about: Investigate an uncertain direction without treating it as approved implementation
title: "[RFC] "
---

## Question and why now

What choice would this research enable?

## Known constraints

Local-first; source/copyright entitlements; provider independence; real A4 print; low operational costs.

## Options and evidence

Separate facts, assumptions and unknowns. Include upstream documentation and dated tests where possible.

## Smallest experiment

Use original or clearly permissioned fixtures; do not introduce real credentials or paid services by default.

## Decision gate

- [ ] Adopt / adapt / reject / defer, with rationale.
- [ ] Record owner/ADR if consequential.
- [ ] Map concrete follow-up work to master ledger #43 and WORK_LEDGER.
